sn6.10:1.1: A difficult problem of this text (also at [an10.89]()) is the meaning of the numbers counting the duration of hell. The extended version at [snp3.10]() has an extra method of calculating this which is essential to decode them, so I discuss them in the notes there and summarize here.
sn6.10:3.3: The duration of the Pink Lotus hell is claculated in two ways here, plus a simile, with an extra method in [snp3.10]().
sn6.10:6.1: Duration by the “Kosalan load” comes to either 150 billion years (using the Arthaśāstra _khāri_) or 25 billion years (using the Pali _khāri_). Neither of these results agrees with the other calculations in this Sutta. The correspondence is not in the result but the simple numbers: twenty packs each hundred years correspond to the twenty times ten of the hells.
sn6.10:6.2: Ten hells are listed here, the names of which do not correspond with the 21 or 28 listed in Purāṇas, nor with the seven Jain hells, nor with the hells of [mn130](). The commentary offers three explanations for the obscure names of these hells: they are numbers reflecting the duration spent in Avīci; or they are the cries uttered by those suffering there; or they are simply the cold hells.
sn6.10:6.3: The Sanskrit _nyarbuda_ (or _nirbuda_) is said, rather, to be ten times the _arbuda_. The expansion in a series of twenty is required to reach the final number of 512.
sn6.10:6.9: The _sogandhika_ is variously identified as blue or white.
sn6.10:6.11: By this calculation, the Pink Lotus lasts for 10⁷ ×  20⁹ = 5.12 × 10¹⁸ years.
sn6.10:10.2: Here, take an _abbuda_ as 10 million and a _nirabbuda_ as 100 million for a duration of 5.36 × 10²⁵ years.
